name: Chebyshev
theta_nonneg
result.value:
:=
  sum_nonneg fun n hn ↦ log_nonneg (by aesop)
result.informal_description: For any real number $x$, Chebyshev's theta function $\theta(x)$ is non-negative, i.e., $\theta(x) \geq 0$.

name: Chebyshev
theta
result.value:
:=
  ∑ p ∈ Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊ with p.Prime, log p
result.informal_description: The function $\theta(x)$ is defined as the sum of $\ln p$ over all prime numbers $p$ satisfying $0 < p \le \lfloor x \rfloor$. Formally, $\theta(x) = \sum_{\substack{p \in (0, \lfloor x \rfloor] \\ p \text{ prime}}} \ln p$.

name: Chebyshev
theta_mono
result.value:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
  · exact filter_subset_filter _ <| Ioc_subset_Ioc_right <| floor_mono hxy
  · simp only [mem_filter]
    exact fun p hp _ ↦ log_nonneg (mod_cast hp.2.one_le)
result.informal_description: Chebyshev's theta function $\theta(x)$, defined as the sum of $\ln p$ over all primes $p \leq x$, is monotonic. This means that for any real numbers $a$ and $b$ with $a \leq b$, it holds that $\theta(a) \leq \theta(b)$.

name: Chebyshev
theta_le_log4_mul_x
result.signature: {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : θ x ≤ log 4 * x
result.type: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 ≤ x → Chebyshev.theta x ≤ Real.log 4 * x
result.value:
:= by
  rw [theta_eq_log_primorial]
  trans log (4 ^ ⌊x⌋₊)
  · apply log_le_log <;> norm_cast
    exacts [primorial_pos _, primorial_le_4_pow _]
  rw [Real.log_pow, mul_comm]
  gcongr
  exact floor_le hx
result.informal_name: Chebyshev's Theta Function Upper Bound: $\theta(x) \leq \log(4) \cdot x$
result.informal_description: For any non-negative real number $x$, Chebyshev's theta function $\theta(x)$, defined as the sum of $\ln p$ over all primes $p \leq \lfloor x \rfloor$, satisfies the inequality $\theta(x) \leq \log(4) \cdot x$.
